notes.title: Congratulations to the winners of the SudoKube contest!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41518892/652ff88e929e29e8c35f2211542f0e64a9b75f30.png[/img]

[h1]We'd like to congratulate the first players to complete our unique souls-like 4x4 SudoKube![/h1]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41518892/1098dc8562aeb46aa23e63bfd11d6b2bcc4de978.jpg[/img]

Thank you so much for putting so much time into our game. It fills our hearts to know that we developed something that motivated people to dedicate so many hours to complete it. Thank you for all the support and feedback provided during this mission!

As promised, everyone who has met all of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1770230/view/3314098953823917439]contest[/url] prerequisites has already received keys for all of our games. They will also receive a key for every game we release in the future.
This might not seem like much today, but I hope it's worth a lot someday :)

[i]If you're one of the top 10 and haven't completed the other prerequisites yet, there's still time ;)[/i]

notes.title: Countdown for SudoKube launch! Join this contest and try to WIN a free key!
notes.content:
We are almost lauching SudoKube on Steam!
And starting this countdown, every day on twitter we will post a sudoku challenge.

The first 5 people to correctly answer all 7 countdown challenges on twitter, will receive a game key!

The rules are:
- Follow Mandinga's twitter page!
- Retweet all 7 challenges!
- Be one of the first 5 people to answer the 7th challenge (you can answer the previous 6 any time before the 7th challenge is published)!

Check them at:
https://twitter.com/mandingagames


Don't forget to Wishlist NOW!
